payload.title: Verify first: check sibling outputs before promoting a change
payload.description:
Improving one checklist question must not quietly make another worse. NOTE: found by reading, not by running; write a failing test first to confirm.

Current: outputs share one request, so A's rubric changes B's context; siblings are pinned and stale ML models refit (shared_decisions.py:34-44; learning_loop.py:88-89); A's candidate is evaluated only on A's development labels (learning_loop.py:137, 164-172). No check on B found.

Desired: promotion also checks every sibling's development score, or records sibling effect and refuses regressions.

Acceptance: a candidate that helps A and hurts B on B's dev set is dropped or flagged under a declared policy; the event records the effect on each sibling.
